privacy.ai_training_note: Azure AI Translator (API/enterprise) and Microsoft Translator Pro explicitly do NOT store or train on submitted customer data: 'Customer data submitted for translation to Azure Translator isn't stored permanently and not data is stored at rest. There's no record of the submitted text or document in any Microsoft data center.' CRITICAL EXCEPTION: Free consumer products (translator.microsoft.com web app, Translator mobile apps, Bing Translator, Edge Translator) DO record data for service improvement. Businesses must use the paid Azure AI Translator API or Translator Pro to benefit from the no-trace guarantee.
privacy.data_region: Within the customer's own Azure subscription and selected Azure region. Custom Translator documents stored encrypted in the customer-selected region until deleted or account expires.

security.name: Bug Bounty Program
security.value: Microsoft runs its own MSRC (Microsoft Security Response Center) bug bounty, NOT HackerOne or Bugcrowd. Azure scope awards $1,250 to $60,000 USD. Submissions through msrc.microsoft.com/en-us/msrc/bounty-microsoft-azure.

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Annual independent third-party audits for SOC, ISO, FedRAMP, and HIPAA certifications. Microsoft also runs internal red-team exercises.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS for all data in transit. All API calls must use HTTPS.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Custom Translator documents stored encrypted in the customer's selected Azure region. Customer-managed key (CMK) support available.

security.name: Data Isolation
security.value: All organizational data remains within the customer's Azure subscription. No data is shared with Microsoft from the paid API tier.

security.name: No-Trace Policy
security.value: Text, voice, and documents submitted to Azure AI Translator are processed in memory only and not written to any persistent storage. No records exist in any Microsoft data center after the API call completes.

security.name: Secure Future Initiative
security.value: Microsoft's company-wide Secure Future Initiative puts security above all else; documented at https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/trust-center

products.name: Microsoft Translator (Consumer Web and Mobile App)
products.data_scope: Free tier. Data IS logged for service improvement. No enterprise data-processing agreement. translator.microsoft.com is retiring June 30, 2026.
products.notes: Not suitable for sensitive or regulated workloads. Use Azure AI Translator API instead.

products.name: Azure AI Translator (API)
products.data_scope: Pay-as-you-go and committed-use API. No data stored at rest. No training on customer data. Full no-trace guarantee. Data stays within customer's Azure subscription.
products.notes: Supports text, document, and custom translation. Available via Azure AI Foundry. Full compliance stack (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP High, HIPAA).

products.name: Microsoft Translator Pro
products.data_scope: Real-time speech-to-speech translation. No data stored at rest. No data retained for model improvement. Requires Microsoft 365 enterprise subscription.
products.notes: iOS only (requires iOS 15+). Backed by the same Azure AI Translator no-trace guarantee.

products.name: Translator in Microsoft Teams / Microsoft 365
products.data_scope: Follows Microsoft 365 data handling policies and the customer's M365 DPA. Subject to M365 compliance boundaries.
products.notes: Data residency and compliance governed by the organization's M365 tenant settings.

products.name: Custom Translator
products.data_scope: Customer uploads training documents; stored encrypted in customer-selected Azure region until deletion. Data used exclusively for the customer's own custom translation system. Microsoft does not use documents for other purposes.
products.notes: Customer-managed keys available. Data deleted on account expiry or explicit delete.

compare.pricing_model: Consumer: free (web, mobile). Azure AI Translator: pay-per-character (S0 free tier up to 2M chars/month; paid tiers scale from $10/M chars). Custom Translator: pay-per-character. Translator Pro: enterprise licensing via M365.
compare.data_residency: Azure AI Translator and Custom Translator: data stays within the customer's Azure region/subscription. Consumer apps: data processed on Microsoft global infrastructure with no region guarantee.

flags: RETIREMENT: translator.microsoft.com (consumer web app) is retiring June 30, 2026. Users are directed to download the Microsoft Translator mobile app.

CONSUMER VS ENTERPRISE DATA SPLIT: The free consumer tier (web, app, Bing Translator) DOES log data for service improvement. Only the paid Azure AI Translator API and Translator Pro carry the no-trace guarantee.
BUG BOUNTY: Microsoft operates its own MSRC bounty program (not HackerOne or Bugcrowd) with payouts up to $60,000 for Azure-scope findings.
CUSTOM TRANSLATOR: Training documents for custom models ARE retained in the customer's Azure region until explicitly deleted.
